classification_definition.counts: request totals pool descriptive counts, while latency and fraction ranges preserve run-level estimates; P/F/I/U criteria and offered denominators are unchanged
classification_definition.criteria_source: campaign.measurement, applied to admitted cells exactly as campaign_analysis.py passes expression
classification_definition.queue_only: valid fail; all three response criteria and resource guard pass; only recorded queue criterion fails
classification_definition.ranges: min/max of independent run values; successful p95 uses successful responses only; null means no observed value; not a confidence interval
classification_definition.response_and_queue: valid fail; at least one response criterion and queue criterion fail; resource guard passes

scope_limits: Compact population controls contain 48 records per Pod and do not establish million-Pod retained-history service capacity.
The largest measured retained-history population is 1000 Pods; full-service million-history admission remains false.
The load uses frozen scenario assumptions and uniform read selection; it is not an empirical arrival trace of a million Solid users.
All requests are colocated HTTP measurements. External network and multi-request user-journey latency are unmeasured.
CPU count is taskset affinity, not a CPU bandwidth quota. Configured memory tiers are server limits on a larger host, not a minimum whole-machine specification.

Memory peaks include warmup and cgroup-charged page cache. Before/after CPU deltas cover the measured client window and client drain; outstanding warmup work may overlap, and unfinished measured work may survive the after snapshot and be killed at server stop. No CPU-per-completed-journey estimate follows.

Serialized N-Quads source bytes are not persisted storage. Packed-plus-index measures two file lengths; whole-corpus allocation is pre-load du accounting including inventory/manifest. No post-load journal growth or steady-state disk footprint was measured.
Pack/index digests are creation-time remote observations; representative loading checks index shape and authorization results, but does not independently rehash every stored frame.
Missing HTTP status is never imputed. Here all recorded transport errors carry explicit timeout classification; timed-out mutations are separately reconciled against durable receipts.
Paired schedule fingerprints match, but all latency equivalence verdicts remain unestablished. Coarse rate brackets do not identify true maximum sustainable capacity.
